initial_state = ParticleState(
    positions=positions,
    momenta=jnp.zeros_like(positions),
    masses=jnp.ones(2),
)
final_state, trajectory = simulate_velocity_verlet(
    energy_fn, initial_state, time_step=0.02, num_steps=400
)
total_energy = jax.vmap(energy_fn)(trajectory.positions) + jax.vmap(
    kinetic_energy
)(trajectory)
relative_error = (total_energy - total_energy[0]) / total_energy[0]

print(f"trajectory positions: {trajectory.positions.shape}")
print(f"largest relative energy excursion: {float(jnp.max(jnp.abs(relative_error))):.3e}")
print(f"final separation: {float(jnp.linalg.norm(final_state.positions[1] - final_state.positions[0])):.3f}")
